name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart end-to-end. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present), created the quickstart script exactly as documented, and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response contained a Spanish greeting as requested.
deviations: The quickstart specifies model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, which returned a 404 'Model not found' error. I substituted it with `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash-0731`, a currently available chat model from the Fireworks model list, after which the exact same code pattern succeeded.
